column7: Decides whether a task-store mutation runs now, parks or is refused ("restarting") while a restart checkpoint holds the store; the one admission every mutation passes
Decides whether an expiry sweep tick may start while the store is paused, draining or terminal
Builds the store's gate open, with the receiver it keeps for its lifetime; a wrong start state would let writes through a checkpoint
Records a storage failure of admitted work during an attempt, which fails that attempt's checkpoint
Closes the gate for an attempt and stores its deadline and backstop, the bounds every park uses
Moves the gate to certified after the attempt's checkpoint; parks stay parked
Cancel recovery: drains parked submitters before newer arrivals, then opens the gate
A stop signal won: admits parked work and everything after it, no ordering
The commit edge: refuses new external submissions, admits work parked before it and internal completion work
